data.cultural_impact: Sloan has been celebrated in various cultures throughout history. In Scotland and Ireland, the surname Sloan can be found amongst the clans. In the United States, the name Sloan became popular among the English and Irish immigrants. It is also associated with rural and agricultural communities, reflecting its historical roots.
